description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Columbus static site (PETTRIPFINDER-PROD-005A). Consumed by scripts/pettripfinder/assemble_netlify_bundle.py. Contains NO credentials and NO remote project identifiers. The committed hotel-policy package is the single identity authority for the 14 verified hotels; this contract deliberately does NOT duplicate a hard-coded production allow-list.

policy_package.note: The 14 verified hotel identities are DERIVED from this package at assembly time via scripts.pettripfinder.site_data.verified_public_hotels(); they are not restated here. Held/manual-review hotels are the seed hotels absent from this package.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: Every seed hotel absent from the committed package (11 held/manual-review, including Drury Plaza) must have NO public route and NO reference on any surface: hotel profiles, the hotels listing/category page, nearby-lodging cards on any page, the policy-comparison table, the sitemap, canonicals, internal links, and /go/ interstitials.

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits (_build_report.json, _broken_link_report.json, _quality_report.json, bundle_manifest.json) are read for gating but are excluded from site/ and must never ship.
